toggleHelp: Turns off sampling, error capture, and history writes on this panel. Pause only stops this page from refreshing.
toggleError: Could not save the monitoring switch ({status}).
stoppedAt: Collection stopped at {time}. Charts are history, not the current state.
failedHint: New background-task failures in this bucket
p95Peak: Bucket p95 peak, not an average
gap: This range has gaps; the line breaks instead of filling zeros.
partialLatency: Latency stats used a partial sample, so percentiles may be low.
errorsEmpty: No redacted error details in this range.

stale.title: Monitoring data is stale
stale.guidance: Confirm the panel process is running and the collector has not stalled.

request_p95.title: Request p95 is elevated
request_p95.guidance: Inspect slow routes, event-loop lag, and database/Redis latency on the same timeline.

http_5xx.title: 5xx responses observed
http_5xx.guidance: Filter the error center by request source and inspect the slow-route table.

loop_lag.title: Event-loop lag is elevated
loop_lag.guidance: Look for blocking I/O on the event loop and long CPU stretches in this worker.

db_pool.title: Database pool occupancy is high
db_pool.guidance: Capacity includes overflow connections. Watch slow SQL and concurrent checkout.

fd.title: File descriptor usage is high
fd.guidance: Inspect SSH, HTTP, and database connection leaks.

redis.title: Redis is disconnected
redis.guidance: Check Redis connectivity, credentials, and the configured host/port.

unhandled.title: Unhandled request exceptions
unhandled.guidance: Open the error center and inspect the associated request ID and frames.

failed_tasks.title: Background tasks failed
failed_tasks.guidance: Open the activity tray or the matching operation log for the failed job.

log_errors.title: Background ERROR logs
log_errors.guidance: Review the error center summaries; they are redacted and do not include bodies.
